## Self-review checklist

Complete this checklist before removing the "Draft" status and requesting a review.

### Content
- [ ] My changes say what I intended — no accidental edits or leftover test text
- [ ] Spelling and grammar look correct
- [ ] Names, dates, and troop information are accurate

### Preview site
- [ ] The "Deploy PR Preview" action completed successfully (green check in the Actions tab)
- [ ] I clicked the preview link in the bot comment and verified the page looks right
- [ ] Navigation links on the changed pages work
- [ ] Site looks acceptable on a phone screen (resize browser or use DevTools)

### Ready to merge?
